Nummus (copper alloy) of Constantine I. Reece period 16 [317-330]. Obverse description: Diademed bust right. Obverse inscription: Illegible. Reverse description: Wreath with VOT X within. Reverse inscription: [CAESA]RVM NOSTRVM. Degree of wear: Very worn: fair. Fourth Century reverse type: CAESARVM NOSTRORVM
